chapter: Compositions, singers and the end of the big band
title: Fear of flying and his first plane trip
summary: After taking too many pills in Detroit he had to fly to Washington.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Okay. When did you first go to Europe? Or, when did you first leave the States?

Well, you know, it's funny about me going to Europe. All during the big band years, I've had offers to come over there for quite, for quite a bit. It would have been during the war. And, I couldn't see myself flying then. I wasn't too crazy about flying. I'd never been up in the air. So, I said well. You know, my records were pretty hot over there and I said well. I turned down every European
job. I said when they build a bridge where I can drive over there, I will, I will cause I'm not getting in an airplane. You know?

So, what got me in an airplane first was in Detroit. I had taken too many, I went to a, had a doctor come over to the theater. I told him I felt drowsy. I wanted something to make me relax. I'd just left Chicago. He gave me a certain pill to take cause I hadn't been to sleep or nothing. So, I took too many during that week. And at the end of the week, it seemed like things weren't acting right where I'd pinch myself, my skin would puff up. And then, I actually had too many. And, I couldn't go to the bathroom like I wanted.

So, I had to let the band go without me to Washington, to the Howard Theatre, until I got myself straight. So, the doctor came in and said you just had too many pills. So they gave me some kind of injection, you know, and I stayed there for about 2 or 3 days.
Now, I've got to get on the plane to catch up with my band. I've never been on

this plane before. Now, I was scared to death. But, I got on it. But after that, I've been flying ever since. You know, it was beautiful. I didn't mind it. But that first trip, that's what got me, see? Yeah, I couldn't make it.
Now, every time I've got something important, I've got to go, I don't mind getting in there.
